text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ryan! Have you had a chance to see the
game
from the other day?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Bottom of the ninth, two outs and all
bases
loaded! They were positively
cornered! Yet
somehow they pulled off
the most miraculous—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I most certainly will not! Just thinking
about that
moment makes me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Stop, stop! Do you really wanna talk
about this where
people can hear you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-ahaha. Whatever do you mean? A
Mejiro would
never be having any
unrefined conversation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me, I just received the
most
wonderful tea leaves. Why don't
we go have
some?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, so that's your cover, huh? All
right, let's
go have some tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Tea... That's all we're doing!
